sop_dir.ask: Folder holding the ZS Xplorer SOPs (.zsop) agents may run
sop_dir.help: Save each SOP from ZS Xplorer into one folder; nothing outside it can be loaded.

export_dir.ask: Folder the measurement records are exported to

allowed_sops.ask: SOP file names an agent may run (JSON list; empty = any in the folder)

max_minutes.ask: Longest measurement before the job is failed

sdk.ask: SDK assembly and member names (JSON object), from Malvern Panalytical's SDK documentation
sdk.help: The shipped names are placeholders; correct them from the ZS Xplorer SDK reference before the first hardware test.
